working_tree_note: The tested source file matches source_commit; evidence files were generated in the working tree after the source commit.
case: PostgreSQL custom enum-array multidimensional XLSX re-import through Gnumeric
contract: A 2 by 6 custom enum array with dimensions [0:1][-4:1] preserves literal NULL, an empty label, a SQL NULL element, Unicode, quotes, whitespace, a backslash, and a formula-shaped label.
PostgreSQL type, dimensions, JSON, array_send bytes and typed rebinding agree; SQL replay restores the same array bytes and preserves a sibling row.
Gnumeric re-saves the XLSX as ODS and back to XLSX; all three workbooks retain the exact array text in a string cell without formulas.

focused_test.command: BOOKIEE_XLSX_REIMPORT_ARTIFACT=<evidence-dir>/source.xlsx rtk proxy cargo test --locked -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration value_contract_custom_enum_array_multidimensional_lower_bounds_export_as_spreadsheet_text -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

consumer_assertions.result: Exact array text, string-cell type, and no-formula assertions pass on source XLSX, Gnumeric-saved ODS, and Gnumeric-saved XLSX.

remaining: Other spreadsheet applications and enum-array shape permutations remain open.
